newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moody's has Shell Australia on upgrade review.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's has Shell Australia on upgrade review.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday it had placed the Euronotes and Eurobonds of Shell Australia Ltd under review for possible upgrade.
The bonds and notes are rated A1.
The Prime 1 commercial paper rating by the local unit of the Royal Dutch/Shell Group was confirmed.
The ratings agency said the review was prompted by Shell Australia's financial position and its progress in building its exploration and production operations offshore Australia.
The review would focus on the implications of recent major oil and natural gas reserves in the North West Shelf on Shell's future capital spending, financial leverage, and financing policies.
"The rating review will also evaluate the outlook for and impact of highly competitive conditions and poor returns in Shell Australia's core refining and marketing operations," Moody's said.
